original_query: Which region of the world accounts for the highest percentage of 2010 revenues?

summaries.summary: The image displays a map titled 'GLOBAL REACH' showing the distribution of Alcatel-Lucent's 2010 revenues by region, with percentages for North America (~36%), Europe (~32%), Asia Pacific (~18%), and Rest of world (~14%). It also includes a legend for employee nationalities and worldwide presence, noting over 130 countries and over 100 employee nationalities.
key_facts: North America accounts for ~36% of 2010 revenues.
Asia Pacific accounts for ~18% of 2010 revenues.
Rest of world accounts for ~14% of 2010 revenues.
Alcatel-Lucent has a worldwide presence in more than 130 countries.
Employee nationalities span more than 100 countries.
